name: WDB Asset Parameter
upgrade_notice: Assets are now versioned by file modification time instead of the current time, so browsers cache them until they change.
author: Ralf Longwitz, Webdesign Burgdorf

sections.description: Appends a parameter "wap" with the file's modification time to every local CSS and JS URL on frontend pages, so browsers fetch an asset again whenever it changes.
sections.installation: Upload and activate. There are no settings. The exclusion list can be changed with the wdb_asset_parameter_excludes filter.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Use the file's modification time instead of the current time, so assets stay cached until they change.
  • External assets are no longer modified.
  • Exclusions are matched against the URL path only; query replaced by jquery.
  • New filter wdb_asset_parameter_excludes to change the exclusion list.
  • Fixed relative require path, added direct access check, prefixed function names.

1.0.1 – 1.0.6

  • Test releases for the update mechanism.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
